home.heroTitle: Prepare Your U.S. Immigration Application With Confidence.
home.heroSubtitle: Answer guided questions, organize your immigration documents, find missing information, and request professional review before you file.
home.trustLine: Private immigration preparation technology. Not affiliated with USCIS or any U.S. government agency.
home.step1Title: Tell us about your U.S. immigration situation.
home.step2Title: Prepare your information and supporting documents.
home.step3Title: Continue on your own or request professional immigration review.
home.transparencyTitle: Transparent About What You're Paying For
home.transparencyBody: USCIS forms are available free from the United States government. AGH American Immigration charges only for its technology, guided preparation tools, document organization, quality review, and optional professional services.
home.journeyTitle: Built for the American Immigration Journey
home.journeyBody: Whether you are preparing for U.S. citizenship, helping a family member immigrate, organizing documents for USCIS, or requesting professional review, your entire application journey can live in one secure workspace.
home.journeysSectionBody: You don't need to know which USCIS form applies. Start with what's happening in your life, and we'll help you find the right path.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A guided, secure path from your first question to your completed application package.
howItWorks.step1Body: Choose the plain-language description that matches your life, not a government form number.
howItWorks.step2Body: Work through a conversational questionnaire at your own pace. Save and return any time.
howItWorks.step3Body: Upload evidence into a secure vault and get a personalized checklist for your situation.
howItWorks.step4Body: We highlight gaps, inconsistencies, and issues that may need a closer look before you file.
howItWorks.step5Heading: 5. Request professional review when you're ready
howItWorks.step5Body: Ask an immigration attorney, reviewer, or nonprofit partner to look at your materials.

services.title: U.S. Immigration Services
services.subtitle: AGH American Immigration is organized around real-life situations, not form numbers. Explore the journeys we support today and what's coming next.

naturalization.title: Naturalization Preparation
naturalization.subtitle: Structured preparation for lawful permanent residents applying for U.S. citizenship.
naturalization.intro: This guided workflow helps you organize the information commonly needed for a naturalization application: your identity, history, family, travel, and background questions.
naturalization.disclaimerHeading: What this workflow does not do
naturalization.disclaimerBody: Based on the information you provided, we identified items that may need additional documentation or professional review before you file. This platform does not make a final legal determination of naturalization eligibility.

professionalReview.title: Professional Immigration Review
professionalReview.subtitle: Request review from a member of our internal professional network when you want a second set of eyes.
professionalReview.body: Professional review is separate from using the preparation platform. Purchasing a review does not create legal representation and does not generate any government form on your behalf.

affordableHelp.title: Affordable Immigration Help
affordableHelp.subtitle: I Need Affordable Immigration Help
affordableHelp.body: Tell us about your situation and budget. We'll help identify possible review, referral, or nonprofit assistance options.
affordableHelp.notice: Submitting this request does not guarantee that an attorney or nonprofit organization can accept your matter. Your information will be used to identify possible review, referral, or assistance options.

forAttorneys.title: For Immigration Attorneys
forAttorneys.subtitle: A future professional workspace for verified immigration attorneys.
forAttorneys.body: Attorney accounts require identity verification, bar number and jurisdiction confirmation, bar-status confirmation, conflict-check acknowledgment, and scope-of-engagement acceptance before accessing any client matter. This role is a protected placeholder in the current MVP.

forNonprofits.title: For Nonprofit Organizations
forNonprofits.subtitle: A future workspace for DOJ-recognized nonprofits and accredited representatives.
forNonprofits.body: Nonprofit case manager accounts will support intake, referral routing, and case tracking for immigration service organizations, including our partner Anaya's Way Immigration Advocates. This role is a protected placeholder in the current MVP.

about.title: About Anaya Global Holdings
about.subtitle: The company behind AGH American Immigration.
about.body1: Anaya Global Holdings builds technology that helps immigrants and their families prepare for U.S. immigration processes in a more organized, affordable, and understandable way.
about.body2: AGH American Immigration is a private technology platform. It is not a government agency, not a law firm, and not affiliated with USCIS, the Department of Homeland Security, the Department of State, or any U.S. court.
about.body3: Our long-term vision is to become the operating system for U.S. immigration application preparation and professional review — supporting individuals, families, attorneys, nonprofits, employers, and community organizations.

legalDisclaimer.title: Legal and Professional Disclaimer
legalDisclaimer.body1: AGH American Immigration is a private immigration technology platform. It is not a law firm, does not replace an attorney, and does not guarantee eligibility, approval, or any immigration result.
legalDisclaimer.body2: Automated preparation tools and general educational information are not a substitute for individualized legal advice. No attorney-client relationship is created by using this platform. An attorney-client relationship is created only through an express, documented professional engagement.

govNonAffiliation.title: Government Non-Affiliation Notice
govNonAffiliation.body: AGH American Immigration is not affiliated with USCIS, the Department of Homeland Security, the Department of State, the Executive Office for Immigration Review, or any U.S. government agency. USCIS forms are available free of charge directly from the U.S. government.
